description: Product context definition. Why we're building this, for whom, what success looks like. Maintained by humans, consumed by agents as authority. Produced by /setup phase 0.

vision.audience: Who it's for (be specific - role, org size, workflow)
vision.why_now: Why this needs to exist now, not later
vision.differentiator: What makes this different from alternatives

success_metrics.measurement: How and where this is measured (PostHog event, database query, manual count)

personas.name: Persona label (e.g. 'Portfolio Analyst')
pain_points: What's hard or broken in their current workflow

current.success_criteria: How we know this is done

next.depends_on: What must be true before starting this

external_connectors.name: System name (Azure, PostHog, Linear, Marsoft Engine, etc.)
external_connectors.purpose: What this connector does for the product
external_connectors.cost_model: How this costs money (per-request, per-seat, flat)

constraints.budget: Cost ceilings and what they bound

team.expertise: What the team knows well vs. is learning
team.availability: Full-time, part-time, shared with other projects

decisions_log.decision: What was decided about product direction
